raw_output:
```sql
SELECT 
    al.airline_type AS airline_type,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.cancelled = 0 AND f.delay_minutes <= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS "on_time_rate [%]"
```

reference_sql: SELECT al.airline_type, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.cancelled = 0 AND f.delay_minutes <= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_airline al ON f.airline_key = al.airline_key GROUP BY 1

question: Яка сумарна тривалість затримок за кожним класом причин? Рахуй лише нескасовані рейси і не враховуй клас «No delay».
sql: SELECT c.class_label AS cause_class, SUM(f.delay_minutes) AS total_delay_min FROM fact_flight AS f JOIN dim_delay_cause AS c ON f.delay_cause_key = c.delay_cause_key WHERE f.cancelled = 0 AND c.class_label <> 'No delay' GROUP BY c.class_label ORDER BY total_delay_min DESC, cause_class ASC LIMIT 1000
raw_output:
```sql
SELECT 
    c.class_label AS cause_class,
    SUM(f.delay_minutes) AS total_delay_min
FROM fact_flight f
JOIN dim_delay_cause c ON f.delay_cause_key = c.delay_cause_key
WHERE f.cancelled = 0 AND c.class_label <> 'No delay'
GROUP BY c.class_label
ORDER BY total_delay_min DESC, cause_class ASC;
```
reference_sql: SELECT c.class_label AS cause_class, SUM(f.delay_minutes) AS total_delay_min FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_delay_cause c ON f.delay_cause_key = c.delay_cause_key WHERE f.cancelled = 0 AND c.class_label <> 'No delay' GROUP BY 1

question: Назви 5 найпопулярніших маршрутів за кількістю рейсів (маршрут у форматі 'XXX-YYY', де XXX — код аеропорту вильоту, YYY — призначення) і кількість рейсів.
sql: SELECT o.iata || '-' || de.iata AS route, COUNT(*) AS flights_count FROM fact_flight AS f JOIN dim_airport AS o ON f.origin_airport_key = o.airport_key JOIN dim_airport AS de ON f.dest_airport_key = de.airport_key GROUP BY o.iata, de.iata ORDER BY flights_count DESC, route ASC LIMIT 5
raw_output:
```sql
SELECT 
    o.iata || '-' || de.iata AS route,
    COUNT(*) AS flights_count
FROM fact_flight f
JOIN dim_airport o ON f.origin_airport_key = o.airport_key
JOIN dim_airport de ON f.dest_airport_key = de.airport_key
GROUP BY o.iata, de.iata
ORDER BY flights_count DESC, route ASC
LIMIT 5;
```
reference_sql: SELECT o.iata || '-' || de.iata AS route, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_airport o ON f.origin_airport_key = o.airport_key JOIN dim_airport de ON f.dest_airport_key = de.airport_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY flights DESC, route LIMIT 5

question: Який коефіцієнт завантаження для кожного типу літака?

raw_output:
```sql
SELECT 
    ac.aircraft_type AS aircraft_type,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.cancelled = 0 THEN f.passengers END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.cancelled = 0 THEN f.seats END), 0) AS load_factor
FROM fact_flight f
JOIN dim_aircraft ac ON f.aircraft_key = ac.aircraft_key
GROUP BY ac.aircraft_type
ORDER BY load_factor DESC, ac.aircraft_type ASC;
```
reference_sql: SELECT ac.aircraft_type, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.cancelled = 0 THEN f.passengers END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.cancelled = 0 THEN f.seats END), 0) AS load_factor FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_aircraft ac ON f.aircraft_key = ac.aircraft_key GROUP BY 1

question: Яка середня затримка рейсів, що вилітають з хабів, за типом авіакомпанії у літній період?
sql: SELECT al.airline_type AS airline_type, AVG(f.delay_minutes) AS avg_delay_min FROM fact_flight AS f JOIN dim_airline AS al ON f.airline_key = al.airline_key JOIN dim_airport AS o ON f.origin_airport_key = o.airport_key JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE o.is_hub = TRUE AND d.season = 'Summer' GROUP BY al.airline_type ORDER BY avg_delay_min DESC, al.airline_type ASC LIMIT 1000
raw_output:
```sql
SELECT 
    al.airline_type AS airline_type,
    AVG(f.delay_minutes) AS avg_delay_min
FROM fact_flight f
JOIN dim_airline al ON f.airline_key = al.airline_key
JOIN dim_airport o ON f.origin_airport_key = o.airport_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
WHERE o.is_hub = TRUE 
  AND d.season = 'Summer'
GROUP BY al.airline_type
ORDER BY avg_delay_min DESC, al.airline_type ASC;
```
reference_sql: SELECT al.airline_type, AVG(f.delay_minutes) AS avg_delay_min FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key JOIN dim_airline al ON f.airline_key = al.airline_key JOIN dim_airport o ON f.origin_airport_key = o.airport_key WHERE d.season = 'Summer' AND o.is_hub GROUP BY 1

question: Скільки рейсів затримано більше ніж на 60 хвилин, за підкласами причин у класі Weather?
sql: SELECT c.subclass_label AS cause_subclass, COUNT(*) AS flights_count FROM fact_flight AS f JOIN dim_delay_cause AS c ON f.delay_cause_key = c.delay_cause_key WHERE c.class_label = 'Weather' AND f.delay_minutes > 60 GROUP BY c.subclass_label ORDER BY flights_count DESC, cause_subclass ASC LIMIT 1000
raw_output:
```sql
SELECT 
    c.subclass_label AS cause_subclass,
    COUNT(*) AS flights_count
FROM fact_flight f
JOIN dim_delay_cause c ON f.delay_cause_key = c.delay_cause_key
WHERE c.class_label = 'Weather' 
  AND f.delay_minutes > 60
GROUP BY c.subclass_label
ORDER BY flights_count DESC, cause_subclass ASC;
```
reference_sql: SELECT c.subclass_label AS cause_subclass, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_delay_cause c ON f.delay_cause_key = c.delay_cause_key WHERE c.class_label = 'Weather' AND f.delay_minutes > 60 GROUP BY 1
